patches_modified.description: Disables CHZZK peer-assisted grid streaming and forces CDN playback.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Disables CHZZK advertisements, including live stream pre-roll, mid-roll and post-roll ads and clip feed ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide home banners
patches_modified.description: Hides promotional banners on the CHZZK home recommend tab, including the top banner carousel and the in-feed event and image banners.

patches_modified.name: Unlock cheat key
patches_modified.description: Unlocks CHZZK cheat key subscription benefits without an active subscription.

patches_modified.name: Disable P2P
patches_modified.description: Disables SOOP peer-assisted grid streaming.

patches_modified.name: Remove Catch ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the ads inserted between clips in the Catch feed by reporting no ad slots.

patches_modified.name: Remove VOD ads
patches_modified.description: Removes VOD pre-roll ads by reporting every stream as QuickView Plus to the player's own ad-skip check.

patches_modified.name: Remove banner ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the VOD companion and search banner ads.

patches_modified.name: Remove exit dialog ad
patches_modified.description: Removes the ad area shown in the app-exit confirmation dialog, keeping the dialog itself.

patches_modified.name: Remove intro ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the image, video and cinema intro ad banners shown on launch.

patches_modified.name: Remove list banner ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the native banner ads under the live player and in feeds by stopping their ad request, so no banner is fetched or shown.

patches_modified.name: Remove live ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the live pre-roll ad by routing every ad decision into the app's own no-video path so the stream starts immediately.

patches_modified.name: Remove live banner ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the banner ads shown under the live player by stopping their driver from attaching the banner fragments.

patches_modified.name: Remove main board ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the native "main board" banner ad shown in feeds and under the live player.

patches_removed.name: Movie Paradise - Force RevenueCat entitlement (experimental)
patches_removed.description: Forces RevenueCat entitlements active. Experimental: premium is server-authoritative, so this likely unlocks nothing.

patches_modified.name: Force stream XR gates

patches_modified.previous_description: Bypasses the three verified XR gates in builds 5001712 and 5002244.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR high-resolution 3-projection fix
patches_modified.description: Permission-free resolution fix for exact builds 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, and 5002363. Preserves each build's native projection layout (2 layers on the supported 2.0.20 and 2.0.21 builds; 3 layers on supported 2.0.22 and 2.0.23 builds) and source formats, including future RGB10_A2, while appending a static 2x2 Android-surface compositor trigger with no image copy or reconstruction.
patches_modified.previous_description: Permission-free resolution fix for exact builds 5001712, 5002244, and 5002363. Preserves each build's native projection layout (2 layers on 2.0.20/5001712; 3 layers on supported 2.0.22 and 2.0.23 builds) and source formats, including future RGB10_A2, while appending a static 2x2 Android-surface compositor trigger with no image copy or reconstruction.

patches_modified.name: OLED color calibration
patches_modified.description: OLED calibration with optional VD-informed SDR foveal processing and a separate foveal gamma adjustment, always with 8-bit sRGB output. The VD options bypass the calibration profile on the fovea while retaining Valve's decoder colour correction. Foveal gamma can darken that layer in any mode. Exact builds 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, and 5002363; visible improvement requires headset verification.
